messages.content: How do I reset my password?
Open Settings, then choose Security and Reset password.
Where can I download an invoice?
Open Billing, select the invoice, and choose Download.
How do I change my email address?
Open Profile, enter your new email, and verify the address.
Open Billing and choose Cancel subscription.
Where can I find my order status?
Open Orders and select the order to see its status.
Open Help and choose Contact support.
How do I enable two factor authentication?
Open Security and choose Two factor authentication.
Can I export my workspace data?
Open Settings, choose Data, and select Export.
